title: Latvia and Armenia sign immigration protocol
summary_full: On 7th September, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Armenia, Ararat Mirzoyan, signed a protocol on the implementation of the EU-Armenia readmission agreement.
